templateText: Take the room at least once tonight: a toast, a speech, a song, a scene. Make it about something you believe.
templateHint: Award if #ownerName# held the whole group's attention for a statement or performance.

templateText: Leave with a new contract offer from someone at this party.
templateHint: Award if another player offered #ownerName# paid work.

templateText: Learn something about another guest that you could only have pulled from their data, and let them know you have it.
templateHint: Award if #ownerName# confronted another player with a fact they had no ordinary way of knowing.

templateText: Get a guest to trust you with their hardware tonight: a repair, an upgrade, a diagnostic. Name your price.
templateHint: Award if another player agreed to let #ownerName# work on their gear or chrome.

templateText: Get one guest to confide a medical problem, a habit, or an old injury to you in private.
templateHint: Award if another player told #ownerName# something about their health in confidence.

templateText: Get one guest on the record, by name, about #victimName#. A quote you could publish.
templateHint: Award if a player knowingly gave #ownerName# an attributable statement about the victim.

templateText: Take a statement from at least three guests about where they were when #victimName# died.
templateHint: Award if #ownerName# questioned three different players about their whereabouts.

templateText: #victimName#'s seat is empty. Leave with a commitment from one guest to do business with you once it is filled.
templateHint: Award if another player agreed to a future deal with #ownerName#.

templateText: Broker one deal between two other guests tonight and take your cut, in eddies or in a favor.
templateHint: Award if #ownerName# arranged a deal between two other players and was paid for it.

templateText: Your people need a friend in the city. Secure safe passage or steady work for them from someone here with real pull.
templateHint: Award if another player promised #ownerName# protection, passage, or work.

templateText: #victimName#'s death leaves a vacuum. Get two guests to agree to back you in whatever comes next.
templateHint: Award if two different players pledged support to #ownerName#.

templateText: This house is your way off the Street. Leave with a patron: a job, a sponsor, or a contract with a corporate name on it.
templateHint: Award if another player offered #ownerName# a lasting position or sponsorship.

templateText: Make sure everyone here remembers your name. Be the one who announces something important to the whole room.
templateHint: Award if #ownerName# was the first to reveal a significant fact to the whole group.

templateText: Make one guest visibly back down from you tonight.
templateHint: Award if another player gave ground to #ownerName# out of intimidation.

templateText: People here have heard things about you. Get one guest to speak well of you in front of the others.
templateHint: Award if another player publicly praised or vouched for #ownerName#.

templateText: Go the whole night without telling anyone a true thing about where you came from.
templateHint: Award if #ownerName# never revealed a true detail of their background.

templateText: Someone in this house helped make your life what it is. Pick one guest and make them pay tonight: embarrassed, out of pocket, or in your debt.
templateHint: Award if #ownerName# named a target to the GM and that player ended the night worse off because of them.

templateText: #victimName# died owing you. Get someone here to acknowledge the debt and promise to make it right.
templateHint: Award if another player accepted #ownerName#'s claim and promised compensation.

templateText: Someone you care about depends on tonight going well. Leave with a favor owed to you by the most powerful guest in the room.
templateHint: Award if a high-status player promised #ownerName# a favor.

templateText: Leave richer than you arrived. Get any guest to hand you eddies, for any reason.
templateHint: Award if another player paid #ownerName# anything.

templateText: Nobody gets through a night like this alone. Make one ally here who will stand next to you at the final vote.
templateHint: Award if another player openly sided with #ownerName# during the final accusation.

templateText: Find out what really went on in #location# tonight. Someone was in there who should not have been.
templateHint: Award if #ownerName# established who was in #location# during the evening.
